EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi John,
To follow up on our conversation earlier, below is the set of best practices that we’ve seen for our leads.
This particular study is considering calls only, but it is incredibly important to utilize all methods of communication (phone, text message, email) to reach customers.
Internet Lead Best Practices - Speed to call
Speed-to-call is the single largest driver of lead conversion.
Responding within the first 2 minutes after the lead has been received is critical.
Responding to leads within 1-minute results in a 391% improvement over average close rates.
Calling within the first 30 minutes increases conversion rates by an average of 62%.
Calling within 1 hour improves conversion by an average of 36%.
Response Cadence
Contacting inquiries too slowly, too frequently, or not frequently enough, all result in poor lead conversion rates
Calling 3 times during the first day, once on day 3, again on day 4, and a 6th and final time on day 11 or 12, is the optimal call attempt strategy.
Contact Attempt Cadence
Day 1:
0-5min - 1st Attempt (if no answer hang up and call back immediately after)
1hr-2hrs - 2nd Attempt
2hrs-4hrs - 3rd Attempt
Day 3:
24 hr period - 4th Attempt
Day 4:
24 hr period - 5th Attempt
Day 11 or 12:
48 hr period - 6th Attempt (93% contact rate)
Suggested talk track (email, text, phone):
'Hello, (customer's name) I have a quote ready for your (make, model, year) I just need to verify your date of birth to ensure I give you the most accurate quote.'
Most common objections:
'I did not request a quote'
'Not a problem at all, I already have a quote ready for you. Just to verify is your date of birth ______?'
'I've been called too many times'
'I completely understand your frustration! I definitely don't want to take too much of your time, I can make this as quick as possible because I already have all of your information. I just need to verify your DOB/license number just so I can ensure the quote I am sending you is accurate.
'Stop calling me, I wanted to do this online'
'Not a problem at all we can definitely communicate online! While I have you on the phone I just need to verify your date of birth to ensure that I send you the most accurate quote possible.' (build rapport, ideally, we want to keep them on the line to quote)
'I'm not free to talk at this moment'
'Not a problem. Would it be more convenient if I sent you a text message?' (if yes, verify the date of birth before they hang up. If no, ask to quickly verify their birthdate so you can ensure you are sending them the most accurate quote.)
Should you have any additional questions please feel free to reach out via email or at 844-707-8800 and dial 1 for support.
